material.description: rust/crates/server/Cargo.toml sets default = ["server-tests"], so the cfg gate on --test-panic-tick (room.rs) and --test-panic-mod-tick (mods.rs, not gated) is compiled into release builds. Fix: make server-tests non-default and have CI pass --features server-tests where tests need it, or gate the flags on cfg(test) only; gate mods.rs too.
material.subject: Test-only panic flags reachable in default server build
material.witness: commit f4f7cf5a removed oscraftd and rust/crates/server (git ls-files rust/crates/server is empty); rust/crates/server/Cargo.toml gone; no --test-panic-tick flag in rust/crates
